paper_title: More Tokens, Lower Precision Towards the Optimal Token-Precision   Trade-off in KV Cache Compression
caption: The results of Layer-Wise Quantized Pruning on Mistral-7B-v0.2-Instruct, with SnapKV as pruning method. KV cache budget=1/64.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relative change in performance for various methods of layer-wise quantized pruning on Mistral-7B-v0.2-Instruct using SnapKV as the pruning method, with a key focus on the KV cache budget set at 1/64. The x-axis is labeled "Layer" and displays categorical intervals from "Layer 1-4" to "Layer 29-32," representing specific layers through which the model processes information. The y-axis, labeled "Relative Change," has a linear scale ranging from -25% to 5%, with tick marks indicating intervals of 5%. There are four distinct lines plotted: the yellow line with circular markers represents "LB-Avg of 2×tokens, 8-bit," which exhibits slight fluctuations, starting at approximately -1% at Layer 1-4 and reaching about 4% by Layer 29-32. The red line with square markers denotes "LB-Avg of 1×tokens, 16-bit," starting at roughly -5% at Layer 1-4 and ending at around 5% for Layer 29-32, showcasing a general increasing trend. The light blue line with circular markers indicates "RULER4k of 2×tokens, 8-bit," which initially shows a decrease to about -10% at Layer 5-12 before increasing steadily to around 2% by Layer 29-32. Lastly, the dark blue line with square markers for "RULER4k of 1×tokens, 16-bit" begins at about -10% in Layer 5-12 and has a gradual upward trend, reaching nearly 5% at the end. The dashed gray line marks the baseline for "4×tokens, 4-bit" at 0% across all layers.
